faces.name: Borborygmos
faces.oracleText:
Trample
Whenever Borborygmos deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

faces.name: Borborygmos Enraged
faces.oracleText:
Trample
Whenever Borborygmos Enraged deals combat damage to a player, reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
Discard a land card: Borborygmos Enraged deals 3 damage to any target.

faces.name: Borborygmos and Fblthp
faces.oracleText:
Whenever Borborygmos and Fblthp enters or attacks, draw a card, then you may discard any number of land cards. When you discard one or more cards this way, Borborygmos and Fblthp deals twice that much damage to target creature.
{1}{U}: Put Borborygmos and Fblthp into its owner's library third from the top.
